title_en: Triplex apartment at Residence Kodra e Diellit 2 (ID 4131495)
description_en: At Residence Kodra e Diellit 2, a triplex apartment is for sale, located on the 2nd, 3rd and 4th floors, with a total area of ​​204.23 m² and a net area of ​​141.6 m², a veranda of 22.6 m² and a terrace of 37.2 m². Currently in the final stage, the permits are being placed. The first floor is organized in living room, kitchen, toilet. The second floor is organized in: 2 bedrooms, bathroom, spacious balcony. The third floor is organized in: large suite room with wardrobe, toilet. The terrace is fully in use of the apartment, with a fantastic view of Tirana. For sale, 340,000 euros.
